propositions: Process-local lru_cache on _rendered() causes each xdist worker to independently re-render all 178 corpus bodies and spawn 884 pandoc processes, wasting ~56s CPU per session versus one fill serially
Three test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical parametrizations each recompute pass-1 renders that _rendered() already cached, duplicating ~half the work (~12s per test)
Session-scoped digest-keyed cross-worker artifact shared on disk per stratum with os.mkdir mutual exclusion eliminates cache duplication while keeping all 178 bodies and assertions intact
Stratum sharding with PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER-rotated probe order allows concurrent fills of different shards, reducing cold-session wall time from whole corpus to one stratum
Fallback deadline of 150s below --timeout=300 allows losers blocked on crashed winners to render locally and finish within timeout instead of deadlock
